CVE-2026-45570 (GHSA-m7cr-m3pv-hgrp, GO-2026-5496): go-git's SSH transport wrapped the repository path in single quotes without escaping single quotes inside it when building the remote command, so a path containing a quote could add shell tokens on SSH servers that run the command through a shell; upstream describes the change as defence in depth. It affects github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 up to and including 5.19.0 and is fixed in 5.19.1 by commit 1eeb64bb (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/commit/1eeb64bb913a4ba91c47cf5372e8cc8c2e3f3ad5, 'plumbing: transport/ssh, Shell-quote path'), which adds writeShellQuote to plumbing/transport/ssh and routes the path through it. Sources: https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-m7cr-m3pv-hgrp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5496 and https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.1. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 28 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages), each against the checksum in the repository index. Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath; its Go release and module versions are the same as those of the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information, the same on both architectures, lists github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 v5.18.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.20.4-r2, v5.19.0 in 1.20.4-r3 to 1.20.4-r4, v5.19.1 in 1.20.4-r5 to 1.23.1-r1, v5.19.2 in 1.23.1-r3 to 1.30.0-r0, with no replace directive for that module. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows go-git's SSH transport, plumbing/transport/ssh.(*command).Start, linked in every build. writeShellQuote, the function the fix adds, is present in every build from 1.20.4-r5 on, which carry v5.19.1 or later, and absent from every earlier build. So the earlier builds are affected, and 1.20.4-r5 is the first fixed build.

It affects github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 up to and including 5.19.0 and is fixed in 5.19.1 by commit 1eeb64bb (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/commit/1eeb64bb913a4ba91c47cf5372e8cc8c2e3f3ad5, 'plumbing: transport/ssh, Shell-quote path'), which adds writeShellQuote to plumbing/transport/ssh and routes the path through it. Sources: https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-m7cr-m3pv-hgrp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5496 and https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.1. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository as of 28 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-1 to the current 1.30.0-0, on amd64 and arm64 (50 packages), each against the checksum in the repository index. Each package installs one file, /sbom-indexer, as listed in the md5sums manifest of its control archive, and the MD5 checksum recorded there equals that of the program we read in full from the Alpine 3.23 package of the same version and architecture with the matching revision (for example 1.20.4-5 matches 1.20.4-r5 and 1.21.0-0 matches 1.21.0-r0; 1.26.0-3 matches the 1.26.0-r2 program, which 1.26.0-r3 also carries), so these packages carry the same statically linked Go programs, built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath; its Go release and module versions are the same as those of the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information, the same on both architectures, lists github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 v5.18.0 in 1.20.4-1 to 1.20.4-2, v5.19.0 in 1.20.4-3 to 1.20.4-4, v5.19.1 in 1.20.4-5 to 1.23.1-1, v5.19.2 in 1.23.1-3 to 1.30.0-0, with no replace directive for that module. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows go-git's SSH transport, plumbing/transport/ssh.(*command).Start, linked in every build. writeShellQuote, the function the fix adds, is present in every build from 1.20.4-5 on, which carry v5.19.1 or later, and absent from every earlier build. So the earlier builds are affected, and 1.20.4-5 is the first fixed build.
